pitch: Control your whole WordPress site from Claude — edit pages, publish posts, fix your SEO, just by asking. No developer. No clicking through wp-admin.
pitchMark: Control your whole WordPress site from Claude
problem: You own a WordPress site, but you're not the developer. So the small stuff piles up — a typo on the About page, a price that's out of date, a post that's been 'almost ready' for a week. You click through wp-admin one item at a time, or you send your dev a ticket and wait.

This skill clears that backlog in plain English. You say what you want, and Claude does it the same way you would in your dashboard — only faster. Your password never touches the chat, and anything risky is shown to you first.

callout.label: Content, not code
callout.text: It's a **content tool, not a developer tool**. It changes text, images, fields, and settings — it doesn't build features or touch code. Think **fix it, fill it, publish it** — not "build me a new site."

capabilities.label: What you can do
capabilities.lede: What's possible **depends on how your site was built**. Before it changes anything, Claude scans yours and tells you which of these it can actually do here — it never guesses.

items.name: Edit content
items.desc: Fix a typo, reword a headline, swap an image, correct a detail that changed.

items.name: Draft here, publish live
items.desc: Write a post or page in the chat, then publish it with a category, featured image, and SEO title.

items.name: New pages from a template
items.desc: Duplicate a team or service page and fill in the new content.

items.name: Fix your SEO in bulk
items.desc: Fill in missing meta descriptions; rewrite titles to target a search term.

items.name: Clean the media library
items.desc: Add alt text to every image that's missing it; tidy titles and captions.

items.name: Organize & navigate
items.desc: Manage categories and tags, reorder your menu, schedule a backlog of drafts.

items.name: Users & access
items.desc: See who can log in, add a teammate, offboard a contractor. (Admin account.)

items.name: Custom fields
items.desc: Update the hero text, prices, or bios your templates pull from.

flow.d: One-click WordPress access key, stored safely — never in chat.
Scans your build, so it knows what it can and can't change.
Describe the change you want in plain English.
Shows risky changes first, then makes the edit in seconds.
Logs every change and gets to know your site over time.

commands: fix the typo on my About page
publish the post I wrote — add a category, featured image, and SEO title
find every blog post missing a meta description and write one
add alt text to every image in my media library that's missing it
duplicate my team page for a new hire and fill in their bio
rewrite my services page title to rank for 'plumbing in Denver'
reorder my main menu and add a 'Pricing' link
who has admin access? I'm offboarding a contractor

limits.label: What it can't do
items: **Build features or write code** — it fills fields in; it doesn't create them.
**Install or update plugins or themes** — that stays a wp-admin job.
**Rebuild page-builder layouts** (Elementor, Bricks) — it edits the fields, not the canvas.
**Run store data** — WooCommerce prices and stock need the store's own setup.
**Make hundreds of edits at once** — a few dozen is fine; hundreds is slow.
limits.note: Ask for something it can't do, and it tells you straight — and points you to who can.
